studentModeChoiceVerbatim: 그럼 예산을 느려 한 번 더 시도하는게 맞는 거 같아
assistantOperationalization: In the immediately preceding 4-or-8 choice, interpret this as the smaller increment, retry budget 4. This is an explicit assistant interpretation, not a literal numeric student response or authorization of repeated retries.
knownPriorEvidence: The same map and related budget outcomes already appear in API demonstrations and AI regression tests. This is a configured policy demonstration, not a blind new research forecast or independent map sample.
attribution: Student selected one higher-budget retry and expressed a small-increment preference. AI operationalizes the offered smaller retry budget as 4 while retaining one retry and cap 10. No exact numeric quote, additional retry permission, outcome prediction or student code authorship is inferred.
measurementRules: Preserve both attempt outcomes and sum their actual examined nodes. Retain initial-budget success separately. Stop after at most one additional attempt even if the total cap has unused allowance. Do not modify fixed-budget benchmark rows or the original datasets.

finalBudgetMessage.displayText: 예산을 초과했지만 길이 없다는 뜻은 아닙니다. 더 큰 예산으로 다시 탐색하면 길을 찾을 수도 있습니다.
finalBudgetMessage.editingScope: Preserve the meaning while clarifying finding an existing route rather than budget creating a route; no guarantee of success.

messageScope: User supplied a requested failure notice, not authorization to increase the budget again or change the one-retry policy. Display only on final BUDGET_EXCEEDED, never on success or UNREACHABLE.
